verdict.rationale: There is no documented automatic 'best model' router. The closest evidence is that subagents can be invoked automatically, with @-mentioning as the manual alternative (opencode-docs-42), and that users can assign a specific model to each agent (opencode-comm-1). Together these allow task-based model routing, but only through manual configuration, and OpenCode Zen is just a curated list of models rather than automatic selection. Missing for 10: automatic per-task model selection or routing, documentation of model-routing logic, cost/limit-aware model choice, and hands-on corroboration.
